mapper.select: select count(*) from assignment ass where ass.employee_no = #{employeeNo} and ass.assignment_status = '게시' and ( ass.assignment_due_date is null or ass.assignment_due_date > systimestamp )

select * from ( select ass.assignment_no, ass.course_no, c.course_title, ass.assignment_title,
case when ass.assignment_status = '마감' or ( ass.assignment_due_date is not null and systimestamp >= ass.assignment_due_date ) then '마감' else '제출가능' end as assignment_phase,
ass.assignment_due_date
from assignment ass
join course c on ass.course_no = c.course_no
where ass.employee_no = #{employeeNo} and ass.assignment_status = '게시' and ( ass.assignment_due_date is null or ass.assignment_due_date > systimestamp )
order by ass.assignment_due_date asc nulls last, ass.assignment_no desc )
where rownum <= 5
select count(*) from exam e where e.employee_no = #{employeeNo} and e.exam_status = '공개' and systimestamp >= e.exam_start and systimestamp < e.exam_end
select count(*) from exam e where e.employee_no = #{employeeNo} and e.exam_status = '공개' and systimestamp < e.exam_start

select * from ( select e.exam_no, e.course_no, c.course_title, e.exam_title,
case when e.exam_status = '마감' or systimestamp >= e.exam_end then '종료'
when systimestamp < e.exam_start then '예정'
else '응시가능' end as exam_phase,
e.exam_start, e.exam_end
from exam e
join course c on e.course_no = c.course_no
where e.employee_no = #{employeeNo} and e.exam_status = '공개' and e.exam_end > systimestamp
order by e.exam_start asc, e.exam_no asc )
where rownum <= 5

select count(*) from exam e where e.exam_status = '공개' and systimestamp >= e.exam_start and systimestamp < e.exam_end
select count(*) from exam e where e.exam_status = '공개' and systimestamp < e.exam_start

select * from ( select e.exam_no, e.course_no, c.course_title, e.exam_title,
